title: Separating Action Allocation from Image Matching in Visual Token Routing
abstract: arXiv:2611.29477v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Adaptive visual token routers aim to save computation while preserving the image detail needed to answer each question. A higher average score could reflect better choices for individual images or more frequent use of high resolution on tasks that need it. We distinguish the two by keeping action counts fixed within each task and comparing the router's assignments with random pairings of the same actions and images. On equally weighted ChartQA and TextVQA, both Qwen2.5-VL-3B and -7B gain from matching but lose more from their action frequencies relative to a task table, with a 1.71-point gain and a 3.95-point loss on 7B. Exchanging the continuous resolutions chosen by the external selector CARES also lowers quality on 7B. When requests arrive with task labels, the table outscores the discrete router by 1.92 points and saves 31.76 ms per complete 7B request on average.

translated_title: 视觉Token路由中动作分配与图像匹配的分离
translated_abstract: 自适应视觉token路由器旨在节省计算量的同时保留回答每个问题所需的图像细节。更高的平均分数可能反映了对单张图像的更优选择，也可能是在需要高分辨率的任务上更频繁地使用高分辨率。我们通过在每个任务内保持动作数量固定，并将路由器的分配与相同动作和图像的随机配对进行比较，来区分这两种效应。在等权重的ChartQA和TextVQA上，Qwen2.5-VL-3B和-7B都从匹配中获益，但相对于任务表而言，它们从动作频率中损失更多，在7B上分别有1.71分的增益和3.95分的损失。交换外部选择器CARES所选的连续分辨率也会降低7B的质量。当请求带有任务标签到达时，任务表的得分比离散路由器高1.92分，并且每个完整的7B请求平均节省31.76毫秒。
tldr: 该研究提出将动作分配与图像匹配分离的评估方法，发现视觉token路由器的收益主要来自任务级的动作频率（如高分辨率使用频率）而非逐图像的精细匹配，且带有任务标签的简单任务表在准确率和速度上均优于离散路由器。
en_tdlr: This work introduces a method to disentangle action allocation from image matching in visual token routing, revealing that router gains stem mainly from task-level action frequencies rather than per-image matching, and that a simple task table with task labels outperforms discrete routers in both accuracy and latency.
